metaDescription: Deaver, WY sits at the Montana line near the historic Elk Basin field. Get a courthouse-checked, honest read on your Big Horn County mineral interest.
heroLead: Deaver sits right at the state line, close to Frannie, and Elk Basin field straddles the border directly through this corner of Big Horn County.
intro: This field has produced continuously since 1915, one of the true legacy assets of the Bighorn Basin, and its long life has meant repeated rounds of secondary and enhanced recovery to keep pulling oil from formations tapped over a hundred years ago. Big Horn County recorder records around Deaver go back accordingly far, with leases, unit agreements, and probate transfers reflecting several generations of ownership.
If your family's interest sits inside or near the Elk Basin boundary, there's real production history worth checking. I'll confirm your specific position before saying anything about value.

sections.heading: A border field with a long memory
paragraphs: Because Elk Basin crosses into Montana, unit administration and royalty payments here sometimes involve coordination across both states. I make sure your Wyoming-side ownership is confirmed cleanly through Big Horn County records regardless of how the broader unit is structured.
The field's continued investment in enhanced recovery after this many decades signals there's still oil worth chasing here, which affects how I think about remaining value in a producing interest.

sections.heading: Tracing old family ownership
paragraphs: With production history stretching back over a century, Deaver-area interests have often passed through several estates. I trace the recorder's grantor-grantee index as far back as necessary to confirm your exact fractional share before discussing a number.

Frannie and Deaver share this border stretch, and I've traced ownership across both towns for families whose land holdings spanned the two communities. Confirming which specific section your interest falls in matters more than which town address is on the deed.
